SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FICTIONAL PATIENT - NOT FOR CLINICAL USE
COLONOSCOPY REPORT
Date of service: November 9, 2026
Endoscopist: Ines Valdero, MD (fictional)
Procedure: The colonoscope was advanced through the ileocolic anastomosis into the neo-terminal ileum.
Findings: At the ileocolic anastomosis there were two superficial erosions.
Cold forceps biopsies were taken from an inflamed portion of the anastomotic rim.
A 5 mm sessile polyp in the sigmoid colon was removed with a cold snare.
Impression: Anastomotic erosions; rim biopsied; sigmoid polyp removed.
